title: A page and a brief for a power user's own assistant: /sherpa/for-your-claude/ (and /sherpa/for-your-claude/brief/), so a reader like the security expert in the WhatsApp thread can talk his thoughts through with his own Claude, by text or voice, and send us one markdown file
note: At the editor's request, 27 October 2026. The page explains three steps, where to send the file (WhatsApp or email to the editor, the collaborators form with a short three-part version, or the signed Feedback button), what happens to it, and privacy; the brief (records/sherpa/for-your-claude-brief.md, 4,375 characters) makes the assistant interview the person, capture each point with its page and kind, ask for the look and feel specifically (fonts, colours, spacing, light or dark, sites they like), ask whether we may publish (anonymously, with first name, no), and write one file. Built by the Sherpa's block in the press (build_sherpa_claude) and a Copy button (assets/sherpa/claude-brief.js). Tested in a copy of the chain's box: it builds, the page and the Copy button work at 390px and 1280px, and no gate failure is in these pages. Live at team.php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai/sherpa/for-your-claude/ after the chain's next round; the Sherpa checks it live at the next wake. Not yet tried with a live assistant.
